pages.text: Press $(k:key.jobsplus.open_menu) to open the Jobs menu and join two jobs. A job levels up from its own work and pays one $(item)Gold Coin$() per level.$(br2)Two jobs is the most anyone can hold. To swap one, type $(thing)/leavejob <job>$(): it costs 5 gold and deletes that job's level and power-ups for good.

$(l)Coins$() are the money of the realm: 9 $(item)Copper$() make 1 $(item)Iron$(), 9 Iron make 1 $(item)Gold$() (change them at a crafting table).$(br2)They come from job levels, quests, chests, dungeons and bosses. The Jobs menu counts the coins you carry, in gold, and buying a power-up takes them from your inventory, with change given back.

The nine jobs: Alchemist, Cook, Enchanter, Explorer, Farmer, Hunter, Jeweler, Miner and Smith.$(br2)Seven of them also $(l)make$() things nobody else can: Smith, Hunter, Enchanter, Jeweler, Alchemist, Cook and Explorer.
